issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot log in or stay logged in; forced logouts; password reset fails
issues.name: Cannot log in or reset password
issues.description: Users are unable to log into their accounts or get their password accepted, locking them out of the app.

issues.subtopic_definition: Premium-only controls: forced shuffle, skip limits, can't pick songs, features moved behind the paywall
issues.name: Free tier restricts skipping, shuffling and song choice
issues.description: Free users feel basic playback controls such as skipping, replaying, and picking specific songs were removed or locked behind Premium.

issues.subtopic_definition: Lyrics missing, paywalled or out of sync
issues.name: Lyrics missing or fail to display
issues.description: Lyrics are unavailable for some songs or do not show up when expected, making the lyrics feature unreliable.

issues.subtopic_definition: Songs, albums, artists or podcasts missing, greyed out, removed or region-locked
issues.name: Catalog lacks songs and genres
issues.description: Users find that many songs or certain genres such as gospel and reggae are not available in the library.

issues.subtopic_definition: Recommendations, algorithm, repetitive suggestions, Discover Weekly, autoplay/radio picks, shuffle repeating songs
issues.name: Recommendations feel repetitive and unwanted
issues.description: Users are annoyed by the volume and repetitiveness of song suggestions pushed into their experience.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot download, downloads stuck, offline mode not working
issues.name: Offline mode and downloads not working
issues.description: Users cannot download music or play it offline because the offline feature fails.

issues.subtopic_definition: Downloaded/saved music or liked songs disappear or must be re-downloaded
issues.name: Downloads get stuck and stall in background
issues.description: Song downloads stall in the background and only complete when the app is reopened.

issues.subtopic_definition: General criticism or 'bad app' without a specific supported topic
issues.name: General dissatisfaction with app quality
issues.description: Users express broad dissatisfaction, calling the app bad or disappointing, often tied to restrictions, without naming a specific problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: Unrelated, meaningless, unsupported-language, or boycott-slogan text
issues.name: Off-topic or boycott-related text
issues.description: The review contains unrelated political boycott messaging rather than feedback about the app experience.

issues.subtopic_definition: Sound quality, volume levels, equalizer, audio glitches
issues.name: Volume adjustment and audio bugs
issues.description: Volume adjustment does not work properly and there are audio bugs affecting the listening experience.

issues.subtopic_definition: 'No internet connection'/offline errors while online, failure to load or buffer
issues.name: False no-internet errors on Wi-Fi
issues.description: The app reports no internet connection over Wi-Fi even though it works on mobile data, and some song quality is poor.

issues.subtopic_definition: App crashes, freezes, won't open, black screen
issues.name: App crashes or stuck on loading screen
issues.description: The app crashes after updates or freezes on the logo screen, preventing users from opening it.

issues.name: Cannot rewind to replay earlier audio
issues.description: Users cannot step back a few seconds to replay part of a track after a recent update.

issues.subtopic_definition: Music stops, pauses, skips or jumps by itself; songs won't play
issues.name: Playback stops or songs fail to play
issues.description: Music halts partway through, does not resume where it left off, or fails to play through voice assistant requests.
issues.note: Mixes playback stopping mid-song with voice assistant requests that fail to start the songs.

issues.subtopic_definition: Too many, too long, too loud or repeated ads interrupting listening
issues.name: Ads are too frequent and too loud
issues.description: Users feel ads play too often, back to back, and at high volume, interrupting listening for free users.

issues.subtopic_definition: Managing playlists, library, liked songs, queue order, sorting, editing
issues.name: Playlist playback ignores order and limits skips
issues.description: Playlists play in random order and users can only skip a limited number of songs, frustrating attempts to listen to specific tracks.

issues.subtopic_definition: Layout, redesigns, home feed, finding things, confusing navigation, design changes
issues.name: Redesigns make the app harder to use
issues.description: Users dislike the new home screen and frequent design changes, which feel unintuitive and clunky.
